parameters.content:
## ⭐ Review Collector

**Trigger 1**: Webhook 'order-delivered' → Crée review_request en DB
**Trigger 2**: Webhook 'review-submitted' → Save review → AI Summary → Route par note
**DB**: PostgreSQL direct
**LLM**: Ollama pour résumé IA

parameters.query: INSERT INTO review_requests (store_id, order_id, customer_id, token, status, scheduled_at, expires_at, created_at) SELECT o.store_id, o.id, o.customer_id, md5(random()::text || o.id::text || now()::text), 'SCHEDULED', NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days', NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days', NOW() FROM orders o WHERE o.id = {{ $json.order_id }} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_requests rr WHERE rr.order_id = o.id) RETURNING id, token, order_id, customer_id;

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { success: true, reviewRequestId: $input.first().json.id, token: $input.first().json.token } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "qwen2.5:3b", "prompt": "Resume cet avis client en une phrase concise. Note: {{ $json.overall_rating }}/5. Commentaire: {{ $json.comment }}", "stream": false, "options": { "temperature": 0.3 } }

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Decide & Build Update').first().json;
return [{ json: { success: true, reviewId: d.reviewId, rating: d.rating, route: d.route } }];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO analytics_events (store_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES (1, 'workflow_error', '{"workflow": "review_collector", "error": "{{ $json.message }}"}'::jsonb, NOW())
